claims.claim: Revenues totaled $31.6 billion for the second quarter, up 2.3% from the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $0.66, compared to $0.62 in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted EPS was $0.65, compared to $0.54 in the year-ago quarter.
Operating income was $7.0 billion.
Adjusted operating income was $7.5 billion.
Income from continuing operations was $5.0 billion, up 3.6% year over year.
Adjusted EBITDA was $12.3 billion, up 5.2% year over year.
Free cash flow was $4.7 billion, compared to $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Advanced Connectivity service revenue grew 5.1% year over year to $23.5 billion.
Advanced Connectivity operating income increased 20.3% year over year.
Advanced Connectivity EBITDA grew 8.0% year over year.
Advanced Connectivity had 646,000 total consumer and business internet net adds.
The internet net adds comprised 367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless.
Postpaid phone net adds were 432,000.
Legacy revenue declined 25.9% year over year.
The Legacy decline reflects the company's continued decommissioning of its copper-based network.
Latin America revenue increased 16.1% year over year, primarily due to favorable foreign exchange rates and postpaid wireless subscriber growth.
The company reiterates its plan to return $45 billion+ to shareholders during 2026-2028 through dividends and share repurchases.
For 2026, the company projects adjusted EPS of $2.25 to $2.35 with a double-digit 3-year CAGR through 2028.
The company expects free cash flow of $18 billion+ in 2026, $19 billion+ in 2027, and $21 billion+ in 2028.
The company expects its net debt-to-adjusted EBITDA ratio to return to a target in the 2.5x range within approximately three years following the EchoStar transaction.
The company is accelerating the pace of planned share repurchases in 2026 to approximately $10 billion.
Capital investment was $6.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026, compared to $5.1 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Total debt was $144.0 billion at the end of the second quarter.
Net debt was $126.4 billion at the end of the second quarter.
Legacy EBITDA is expected to turn negative after 2027.
The company has a goal of reaching over 40 million total fiber locations by the end of 2026.
